title: Audit the centre-0 producer and reject its declared product embedding (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Combine one corrected actual-centre0 edit specification, its independent source audit, the exact rejection of one declared r128 product placement, and independently checked conditional p2 accounting. No changed native word was emitted or executed, no full physical witness or complete caller is supplied, and no new κ is claimed.

Restoring the first literal H8 centre and retuning its helper precompensation/four affected repairs gives `G=I-U(I-e0e0^T)R`, `RU=2I`, hence `G²=I`, under the inherited normalized [PR #4948](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4948) source. The backward specification uses actual conjugate frames and coupling `−G^T`; it is not a claim that the entire producer is a scalar inverse transpose. All eight H1 repairs remain. Local profile is `{1:2209,2:412,3:510,4:127,5:40,8:1}`, exactly +H8 versus [PR #4948](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4948); scalar edits add 714 ADDs per FULL. All 632 original independent owners and the 408-helper inventory remain in the specification.

The declared placement `A=G⊕I16`, `B=G^T⊕I16` in the scaled all-output product `P(a,b)=ab/128` on `C[y]/(y^128+1)` fails the necessary unit-substitution equality at the first permitted probe e1: output coefficient 0 is 143/4 versus −25/4, residual 42. Stop this placement; no other embedding or producer is excluded. The failed initial PORT0/physical-centre identification remains an explicit negative control.

For an **unrealized** p2 target grant, `P={1:4754,2:824,3:1020,4:254,5:80,8:226}` and `T={4:56,7:14,8:94,9:876,17:224}`. The 816 helpers are counted once; 448 autonomous main jobs remain unproved. A uniform derivative enclosure on `[.0030217758,.00339999]` gives minimum raw margin 12.804117221917453035517808..809. Exactly 12 extra H1 calls, or one rank-12 child, fit uniformly in this additive model; 13 positive-rank calls or one rank-13 child fail at its right endpoint. Finite work, actual endpoint eligibility, both paid tails, compiler reserve and outer transfer remain unfunded/unbound.
